# AX-NEWS — the world's tech news, in English

AX-NEWS gathers 200+ technology sources (and a catalog of 844 feeds in 11 fields and
28 languages), translates every story into English offline, sorts them by topic and shows
them on the web and on office TV screens. Each story links to its publisher.

## Pages

- [Topics](https://ax-news.com/topics): every topic, each with today's stories and an archive by day
- [Daily digest](https://ax-news.com/digest): the day across topics
- [CVE watch](https://ax-news.com/cve): the vulnerabilities that matter (exploited, severe, covered), with what is impacted;
  one page per CVE at https://ax-news.com/cve/CVE-YYYY-NNNNN, weekly recaps at /cve/week/YYYY-Www
- [Translated](https://ax-news.com/translated): stories translated into English from Korean, Chinese, Japanese and more
- [Countries](https://ax-news.com/countries): news by the country of the outlet
- [Feed catalog](https://ax-news.com/feeds): 844 checked RSS/Atom feeds by field, with OPML downloads
- [TV for offices](https://ax-news.com/tv-screens): news on lobby, break room and SOC screens

## Feeds

- CVE watch: https://ax-news.com/cve/feed.xml
- A topic: https://ax-news.com/topic/<key>/feed.xml (keys on /topics)

## Source

Open source, MIT: https://github.com/plkarin/ax-news
